description: This file defines the ImpactDataItem class, which manages impact data items within the Goteo project. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, validating, and deleting impact data items, and references ImpactData and ImpactItem classes.

classes.name: ImpactDataItem
classes.description: A model class representing an impact data item, with methods to manage impact data and impact item associations, persistence, and validation.

methods.name: setImpactData
methods.description: Sets the ImpactData object for this impact data item.

methods.name: setImpactItem
methods.description: Sets the ImpactItem object for this impact data item.

methods.name: getListByImpactData
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ImpactDataItem objects associated with a given ImpactData.

methods.name: getByImpactItem
methods.description: Retrieves an ImpactDataItem based on a given ImpactItem.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the ImpactDataItem to the database, performing insert or update as needed.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the ImpactDataItem, checking for missing impact data or impact item.

methods.name: dbDelete
methods.description: Deletes the ImpactDataItem from the database based on specified conditions.
